uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When damaged by a nearby opposing Melee Pokémon, reflects 12.5% of the damage received back to that opposing Pokémon as Attack-based damage (0.6s CD). When struck by a melee attack, a portion of the damage received is reflected back at the attacker.

Gains 1 stack toward boosted attacks after hitting an auto attack or move, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, all basic attacks become boosted attacks with increased attack speed and additional 30% lifesteal, dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon, and dealing an additional 10% remaining HP damage to them. All stacks decay after 4s of not hitting an auto attack or move. Against wild Pokémon: basic attack damage is capped at 1000; boosted attack damage is capped at 1100; additional remaining HP damage is capped at 350. Becomes a boosted attack with every fifth attack, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Every time a basic attack or move hits an enemy, basic attack speed is increased.
Becomes a boosted attack with every fifth attack, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Every time a basic attack or move hits an enemy, basic attack speed is increased.

The user hurls sand in the designated direction, reducing the field of vision of opposing Pokémon by 50% and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s; increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 2s and auto attack speed by 30% for 3s when this move hits. Hurls sand, narrowing the field of vision of enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. Also increases movement speed and basic attack speed.

The user digs underground, becoming untargetable while underground, and dashes quickly forward. The user then jumps out from underground beneath the first opposing Pokémon hit, after traveling max distance, or when coming into contact with an unpassable wall, increasing the user's Defense and Sp. Def for 4s, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and throwing them for 0.6s. Burrow underground and move quickly in the designated direction, jumping out when coming in contact with an enemy or when traveling the maximum distance. This jump deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.
Strengthens the duration of the throw to 1s. Damage received is reduced for a short time after jumping out of the ground.

The user jumps back and briefly channels, reducing damage received by 45% for 0.9s, and dives forward, dragging all enemies within a small radius to the designated location, then damaging nearby opposing Pokémon afterward. The user can use Dragon Claw during the first half of the channel to add the Dragon Claw hits as a combo attack. This combo attack scoops up opposing Pokémon, dealing damage with both Dragon Rush and Dragon Claw's first attack and stunning them. If the combo attack hits, the user then throws opposing Pokémon back down with the second Dragon Claw attack, dealing damage with a strengthened slow. Back up to create distance before diving to attack in the designated direction, shoving enemies. The user can use Dragon Claw while creating distance at the start of this move to create a combo attack. (This move can crit)
Becomes unstoppable during this move; this includes the combo attack with Dragon Claw. Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are shoved the maximum distance.
The user stomps down on the ground, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. Stomp down on the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

The user jumps up and crashes forcefully to the ground, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s. Two aftershocks follow the initial crash, dealing less damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. Jump high into the air and crash forcefully to the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
Strengthens the movement speed decrease of opposing Pokémon near the center of the crash to 40%. Decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time if they are in this move's area of effect.

The user charges in the designated direction viciously and attacks with two claw swipes. The first attack damages opposing Pokémon and shoves them in the designated direction. The second attack deals more damage to opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed by 45% for 2s. When this move is used in a combo attack with Dragon Rush, the movement speed decrease on the second attack is strengthened to 60% for 2s. Attack twice in front of itself using its claws. The first attack deals damage to enemies and throws them. The second attack deals increased damage. After the move ends, basic attack speed is increased for a short time. (This move can crit)
Increases the damage of both attacks. Increase damage dealt.

The user goes berserk, becoming unstoppable and receiving 30% reduced damage for 5s while unleashing five powerful attacks in a row. The user dashes forward and damages opposing Pokémon in a unique designated area with each attack, taking a brief moment after each attack to aim the next dash. Every attack more damage than the last. The fifth attack throws opposing Pokémon hit and decreases their movement speed by 30% for 1s. The user is left confused for 0.5s afterward. Has the user unleash a powerful chain attack while dashing forward. The final attack throws enemies but also leaves the user unable to act for a short time.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
